description: This file is a shell script used for testing the error handling and various behaviors of 'git update-ref', a command for managing Git references. It contains test functions, setup procedures, and test cases to validate reference update error conditions, conflict scenarios, and symbolic reference operations in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: Tests that updating references with certain conditions fails with the expected error message.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: Performs tests involving adding, deleting, and conflicting references with various options.
